task = 'Place an order for all wrench sets in my amazon wish list.'
print('Task:', task)

# Current wish list (already have token)
wish_list = apis.amazon.show_wish_list(access_token=token)

# Identify wrench sets
wrench_items = []
for item in wish_list:
    pt = (item.get('product_type') or '').lower()
    name = (item.get('product_name') or '').lower()
    if 'wrench set' in name or 'wrench set' in pt or ('wrench' in name and 'set' in name) or ('wrench' in pt and 'set' in pt):
        wrench_items.append(item)

criteria_rows = [
    {
        'Criterion': 'All wrench sets in my amazon wish list',
        'Exact Quote from Task': 'all wrench sets in my amazon wish list',
        'Implementation': 'Filter wishlist items where product_type or product_name indicates "wrench set"'
    }
]
print('CRITERIA TABLE')
for r in criteria_rows:
    print(r)

print('\nWishlist wrench-set candidates (N=%d):' % len(wrench_items))
for wi in wrench_items:
    print({
        'product_id': wi['product_id'],
        'product_name': wi['product_name'],
        'product_type': wi['product_type'],
        'quantity': wi['quantity'],
        'price': wi['price'],
        'inventory_quantity': wi['inventory_quantity']
    })

cart_before = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=token)
print('\nCurrent cart items before any changes:', len(cart_before.get('cart_items', [])))
for ci in cart_before.get('cart_items', []):
    print({'product_id': ci['product_id'], 'product_name': ci['product_name'], 'quantity': ci['quantity']})

# Step 1: clear cart, then add only wishlist wrench sets to cart

print('Clearing cart...')
res_clear = apis.amazon.clear_cart(access_token=token)
print('clear_cart_response:', res_clear)

# Move wrench set items from wishlist to cart
wrench_items = [
    wi for wi in apis.amazon.show_wish_list(access_token=token) if (wi.get('product_type') or '').lower()=='wrench set' or 'wrench set' in (wi.get('product_name','').lower())
]
print('Wrench items to move (N=%d):' % len(wrench_items))
for wi in wrench_items:
    print({'product_id': wi['product_id'], 'product_name': wi['product_name'], 'quantity': wi['quantity']})

for wi in wrench_items:
    print('Moving product_id', wi['product_id'], 'to cart qty', wi['quantity'])
    r = apis.amazon.move_product_from_wish_list_to_cart(
        product_id=wi['product_id'],
        quantity=int(wi['quantity']),
        access_token=token
    )
    print('move_response:', r)

cart_after_move = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=token)
print('\nCart after move: total_cost=', cart_after_move.get('total_cost'))
print('Cart items (N=%d):' % len(cart_after_move.get('cart_items', [])))
for ci in cart_after_move.get('cart_items', []):
    print({'product_id': ci['product_id'], 'product_name': ci['product_name'], 'quantity': ci['quantity'], 'price': ci['price']})

cards = apis.amazon.show_payment_cards(access_token=token)
addrs = apis.amazon.show_addresses(access_token=token)
print('payment_cards_count', len(cards))
print(cards)
print('addresses_count', len(addrs))
print(addrs)
